reasons: Cited text matches the preferred position exactly: Section 28.1 selects New York law (conflicts disapplied, CISG excluded) and Section 28.2 grants exclusive jurisdiction to state and federal courts in New York County with submission to personal jurisdiction and waiver of venue/forum objections.
No arbitration provision is present, so there is no foreign seat or walk-away risk despite the vendor being a UK entity.

The injunctive-relief carve-out in 28.2 and the fifteen-business-day executive escalation in 28.3 are mutual and expressly do not delay urgent relief, so neither impairs access to the agreed New York forum.

Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or comment is proposed and the redline is byte-identical to the original; the deterministic check confirms the governing law is within the accepted set.
